fixed.summary: Activity now reads as documented across its range: 0 a quiet, smooth arc; rays come in from 0.1 and fill the band by 0.5, where the curtain folds; the small folds grow last, and from 0.6 the sheet curls on itself, and above 0.75 the breakup brightens and spreads: wider sheets, the arcs behind nearly as bright as the first, bright surges where they curl with dark breaks between, so 1 is the brightest, most sky-filling stage. The rays were at nearly full strength by 0.15 while the folds stayed a slow wave, so every activity above 0.2 drew the same stacked, evenly rayed bands with straight lower borders.
